perplexity.description:
NOW That's What I Call Rock Anthems is a four-disc compilation released in May 2024 as part of the long-running NOW That's What I Call Music! series. The collection spans 79 rock and power ballad tracks, drawing from multiple decades of rock history to create a comprehensive survey of the genre's most recognizable anthems and stadium-ready hits.

The album showcases rock's breadth across its four discs, featuring classic rock staples alongside new wave and power ballad traditions. Early discs include tracks from artists such as Lenny Kravitz, Blondie, R.E.M., and 4 Non Blondes, while later discs emphasize the power ballad and rock opera traditions with selections from Meat Loaf, Toto, The Police, Foreigner, and Chicago. The collection concludes with Jennifer Rush's "The Power Of Love," positioning the album as a retrospective of rock's most commercially successful and culturally resonant moments rather than a focused artistic statement.

As a special edition within the NOW series' four-disc format introduced in 2021, this compilation represents the franchise's established model of genre-specific collections designed for casual listeners and collectors seeking curated hits rather than deep album cuts. The album was released across multiple formats including CD, vinyl, and digital platforms, with a purple vinyl variant also made available.
